named_as: de Kleer's ATMS extends maintenance to assumption sets and multiple environments
verdict_reason: Corroborated by the editorial introduction to chapter 4 of the Ginsberg reprint collection (p. 258), read directly from the scan, which states that a preliminary version appeared in the Fourth National Conference on Artificial Intelligence [de Kleer, 1984] and refers to further ATMS papers as [de Kleer, 1986b] and [de Kleer, 1986c]. That establishes the 1986 AIJ ATMS series exists and has multiple parts, but does not fix which part P6 means, nor its volume and pages.
promotion_requires: decide which of the 1986 ATMS papers P6 relies on, then retrieve it and read its bibliographic details off the article
p6_delta: Assumption sets and multiple environments are the nearest prior structure to P6's mechanic cells; P6's addition is obligation and authority carried alongside support.
